./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34709:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33274:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29304:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34710:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33275:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29305:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34711:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33276:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37895:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34712:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33277:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29309:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4271:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34713:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33278:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29310:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37897:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34714:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33279:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29344:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34718:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33284:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29352:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37907:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34724:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33290:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29361:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34732:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33299:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29411:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12770:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lmreid_salvage.txt:81:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34733:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33301:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29417:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34736:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33304:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34742:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33311:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13670:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9967:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37932:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34749:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30056:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37943:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34760:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33344:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30216:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:6336:- **训练端三大类全死**：① frozen 重投影/重加权（LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075 — 无 headroom）；② backbone 改 loss（LSRC −1.9 / consistency −1.73 — 损判别力）；③ robust ERM（Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44）。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37944:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34761:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33347:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30342:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37946:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34763:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33400:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37956:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34773:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33411:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30452:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37959:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34776:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33420:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30523:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37961:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34778:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33436:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37962:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34779:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33437:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30548:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37991:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34808:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33504:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30636:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4767:从备选清单看，之前认为可能的第四类已经被你这条消息里的新证据覆盖：LPA/LS-MRT 是 frozen 重加权，LSRC 是改 backbone loss，Hard-Lattice 是 robust ERM，BLC 是 input canonicalize。剩下候选基本会退化进这些桶。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37992:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34809:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33506:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30639:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37993:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34810:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33510:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30646:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4895:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34814:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33514:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30650:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38000:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34817:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33521:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5269:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38003:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34820:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33524:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30660:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38013:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34830:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33546:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30690:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38017:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34834:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33550:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38020:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34837:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33562:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30713:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38041:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34858:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33633:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30906:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:2440:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38066:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34883:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31002:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38067:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34884:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31003:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3946:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38068:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34885:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33699:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38069:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34886:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31005:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38071:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34888:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31009:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3971:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38072:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34889:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31011:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38080:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34897:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33716:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38081:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34898:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33717:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1083:/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "LM-ReID|BLC|LS-MRT|LPA|LSRC|Hard-Lattice|LATS|marginal|low|低分辨率|格点|lattice" experiments -S' in /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38082:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34899:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33732:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38083:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34900:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33733:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38117:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34935:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33812:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4767:从备选清单看，之前认为可能的第四类已经被你这条消息里的新证据覆盖：LPA/LS-MRT 是 frozen 重加权，LSRC 是改 backbone loss，Hard-Lattice 是 robust ERM，BLC 是 input canonicalize。剩下候选基本会退化进这些桶。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38118:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34936:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33814:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38119:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34937:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33818:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4895:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38123:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34941:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38137:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34955:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33860:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6320:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2593:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38144:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34962:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33871:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38146:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34964:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33883:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6514:   - Hard-Lattice ERM 76.9 < 77.44
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38147:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34965:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33884:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38148:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34966:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33889:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6871:   Hard-Lattice `76.9 < 77.44`，说明“训练时照顾最坏格点”不如普通 no-LM 判别训练。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38149:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34967:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33890:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6876:所以我不会再建议什么“便宜训练端新机制”。最多还能做的不是正向机制，而是**论文里的反例补强**：比如把 “ordinary M3 / lattice M3 / no-LM / full-LM / LSRC / Hard-Lattice / BLC 逻辑”整理成 controlled alternatives。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38152:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34970:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33894:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38164:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34982:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33962:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38176:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34994:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33987:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3939:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38177:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34995:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33988:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3946:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5529:- 不同于 Hard-Lattice ERM：不是把每个 lattice 当独立强样本硬训，而是把 K 个 lattice 当 retrieval evidence set。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38178:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34996:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33989:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5543:和 Hard-Lattice 的区别是它不要求每个 lattice 完全独立最优，而是训练不同大小的 evidence bag。适合作为 LSRC 的低成本版本。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38179:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34997:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33990:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38181:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34999:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33992:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:3971:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38184:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35002:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38185:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35003:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34003:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:5228:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。

./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38309:`L_marg/L_cons`、no-LM 对照、ordinary-vs-lattice aug、LSRC 对称/非对称、LS-MRT/LPA/LATS 这些负结果大体可信；但 **Hard-Lattice 不够干净，BLC 没训练，LCRS 没训练**。所以用户质疑是成立的，尤其是 LCRS 不能被“当时负结果”覆盖。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38312:当前 [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:40) 不是明显错跑：
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38314:- lattice 合成当前是合理的：M 默认 3，非 canonical variant 每 epoch 随机 axis/kernel，覆盖 phase/bbox/zoom/kernel；dataset 里 `set_epoch()` 会刷新随机变体。见 [variants](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:130) 和 [set_epoch](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:226)。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38316:- loss 主体实现对：CE 对所有 variants，triplet 改成 per-slot，`L_marg` 是 posterior mean + mean-feature triplet，`L_cons` 是拉到 stop-grad mean embedding/prediction。见 [loss block](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:414)。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38317:- train/test 特征口径基本一致：训练和 eval 都 `pose_dict=None`、global feat、BN neck after、L2 norm；pose/LGPA/GCN 分支不会进。见 [model load](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:321) 和 [forward skip](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/pose_backbone_model.py:705)。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38322:Hard-Lattice 我不敢判干净。代码里 `loss_mode == 'hard'` 只额外 harden CE，不 harden triplet；更关键是 `hard` 没有像 LSRC 那样强制 `lam_marg=0/lam_cons=0`。默认仍是 `1.0/0.2`，若启动命令没显式清零，就会混入已证负的 full LM loss。见 [args/defaults](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:56) 和 [hard loss](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:421)。我没找到能证明当时 Hard-Lattice 命令清零了这两个项的日志。因此 `76.9 < 77.44` 只能算“可疑负/需重跑”，不能当铁证。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38329:- LCRS：**没有训练过**。文档明确写的是排队：`z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + alpha P_k(g_k))`、residual decorrelation、冻结 backbone 训 heads，状态是“排队”。见 [pipeline](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:60)。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38330:- BLC / sampling-lattice canonicalization：**没有训练过**。只有 design 和“bbox 主因子不适合 canonicalize”的数据推断。见 [design_blc](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:1)。
./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38331:- LS-MRT/LPA/LATS：确实跑过，但在其它 probe 脚本，不在 `cvpb_lm_reid_train.py` 主训练脚本里。它们能证明一批 frozen adaptation 无 headroom，不能证明 LCRS 已死。

   130	def _to_target_aspect(img):

   136	def make_lr(hr_img, h, kernel='bicubic'):
   137	    """Deterministic synthetic LR: HR(384x128) --down--> (h, w) --up--> 384x128.
   138	    w preserves the 3:1 canvas aspect: w = round(h/3).  Returns a 384x128 PIL image
   139	    (degrade-then-restore-size, the standard CR-ReID synthetic LR convention)."""
   140	    w = max(1, int(round(h * SIZE_TEST[1] / SIZE_TEST[0])))   # h*128/384 = h/3
   141	    k = _KERNELS[kernel]
   142	    small = hr_img.resize((w, h), k)
   143	    return small.resize((SIZE_TEST[1], SIZE_TEST[0]), Image.BICUBIC)

   146	def make_lattice_variants(hr_img, h, K, rng, fixed_axis=None, jitter_mode='lattice'):
   147	    """K plausible PHASE/CROP/KERNEL variants of the SAME hr image at height h.
   148	    LM-S4 factor ablation: fixed_axis (0=phase,1=bbox,2=zoom) restricts ALL variants to ONE
   149	    lattice axis, isolating which axis drives the test-time gain (cleanest story=phase).
   150	
   151	    Each variant perturbs the SAMPLING LATTICE relative to the scene by a SUB-LR-pixel
   152	    amount, then forms the LR image.  The depicted person is (almost) the same extent;
   153	    only WHICH hr pixels land on each LR sample point changes.  Axes:
   154	      - sub-pixel phase shift  (fractional HR translate before downsample)
   155	      - +/-1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift / expand (integer LR-pixel = h/.. HR pixels)
   156	      - antialias kernel choice
   157	
   158	    variant 0 is ALWAYS the canonical deterministic bicubic LR (no perturbation) so the
   159	    single-LR baseline == variants[0].
   160	    Returns list of K PIL images (each 384x128)."""
   161	    W_hr, H_hr = hr_img.size                      # 128, 384
   162	    # how many HR pixels correspond to 1 LR pixel at this height
   163	    hr_per_lr_y = H_hr / float(h)                  # 384/h
   164	    hr_per_lr_x = W_hr / float(max(1, round(h / 3.0)))  # 128/(h/3) ~ 3
   165	    variants = [make_lr(hr_img, h, 'bicubic')]     # 0: canonical
   166	    kernels_cycle = ['bicubic', 'bilinear', 'lanczos', 'box', 'hamming']
   167	    for j in range(1, K):
   168	        # --- pick a lattice perturbation type round-robin so the K cover all axes ---
   169	        mode = fixed_axis if fixed_axis is not None else (j % 3)
   170	        kern = kernels_cycle[j % len(kernels_cycle)]
   171	        if jitter_mode == 'detector':
   172	            # detector-like localization jitter: continuous Gaussian center-shift + scale error,
   173	            # calibrated to typical detector bbox localization error (sigma ~0.5 LR-px translate,
   174	            # ~10% scale). NOT real detector boxes (Market has no source frame) -- a literature-
   175	            # informed proxy for deployment uncertainty, replacing the uniform +-1 LR-px lattice.
   176	            dx = rng.normal(0, cli.jitter_sigma) * hr_per_lr_x
   177	            dy = rng.normal(0, cli.jitter_sigma) * hr_per_lr_y
   178	            sc = float(np.clip(1.0 + rng.normal(0, cli.jitter_sigma * 0.2), 0.7, 1.3))
   179	            cw, ch = W_hr / sc, H_hr / sc
   180	            cx, cy = W_hr / 2.0 + dx, H_hr / 2.0 + dy
   181	            l, u = int(round(cx - cw / 2)), int(round(cy - ch / 2))
   182	            r, b = int(round(cx + cw / 2)), int(round(cy + ch / 2))
   183	            pad = max(0, -l, -u, r - W_hr, b - H_hr) + 1
   184	            canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W_hr + 2 * pad, H_hr + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   185	            canvas.paste(hr_img, (pad, pad))
   186	            cropped = canvas.crop((l + pad, u + pad, r + pad, b + pad)).resize(
   187	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   188	            variants.append(make_lr(cropped, h, kern)); continue
   189	        if mode == 0:
   190	            # sub-pixel phase: fractional shift of up to +/-0.5 LR pixel (in HR px)
   191	            dx = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_x
   192	            dy = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_y
   193	            shifted = hr_img.transform(
   194	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.AFFINE, (1, 0, dx, 0, 1, dy),
   195	                resample=Image.BICUBIC)
   196	            v = make_lr(shifted, h, kern)
   197	        elif mode == 1:
   198	            # +/-1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift: crop the HR by an integer # of LR pixels on
   199	            # each side then resize back to the HR canvas (== shifting the bbox window).
   200	            sx = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_x))
   201	            sy = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_y))
   202	            left = max(0, sx); upper = max(0, sy)
   203	            right = W_hr + min(0, sx); lower = H_hr + min(0, sy)
   204	            if right - left < 4 or lower - upper < 4:
   205	                left, upper, right, lower = 0, 0, W_hr, H_hr
   206	            cropped = hr_img.crop((left, upper, right, lower)).resize(
   207	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   208	            v = make_lr(cropped, h, kern)
   209	        else:
   210	            # bbox expand / contract by 1 LR pixel (zoom in/out a touch) + kernel swap
   211	            ez = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * 0.5 * hr_per_lr_y   # expand/contract in HR px
   212	            box = (-ez, -ez * (W_hr / H_hr), W_hr + ez, H_hr + ez * (W_hr / H_hr)) \
   213	                if ez > 0 else (abs(ez), abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr),
   214	                                W_hr - abs(ez), H_hr - abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr))
   215	            # PIL crop on a fractional/negative box: emulate via paste on padded canvas
   216	            l, u, r, b = box
   217	            l, u, r, b = int(round(l)), int(round(u)), int(round(r)), int(round(b))
   218	            pad = max(0, -l, -u, r - W_hr, b - H_hr) + 1
   219	            canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W_hr + 2 * pad, H_hr + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   220	            canvas.paste(hr_img, (pad, pad))

   228	def make_tta_variants(lr_img, K, rng, pad=10, strong=False):
   229	    """ORDINARY TTA control: K views of ONE bicubic LR image via pad+RandomCrop (+ hflip).
   230	    NO lattice/phase semantics -- the standard cheap test-time augmentation.  variant 0 ==
   231	    the un-augmented LR so the single-LR baseline is shared with the lattice path.
   232	    strong=True (LM-S2 defense): ALSO add resize-jitter + brightness/contrast = a RICHER TTA,
   233	    so the lattice ensemble must beat a STRONG (not just crop+flip) ordinary baseline."""

   235	    W, H = lr_img.size
   236	    out = [lr_img]                                  # 0: identity (== single LR)
   237	    for j in range(1, K):
   238	        canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W + 2 * pad, H + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   239	        canvas.paste(lr_img, (pad, pad))
   240	        cx = rng.randint(0, 2 * pad + 1)
   241	        cy = rng.randint(0, 2 * pad + 1)
   242	        crop = canvas.crop((cx, cy, cx + W, cy + H))
   243	        if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   244	            crop = crop.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)
   245	        if strong:
   246	            if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   247	                s = rng.uniform(0.8, 1.0)
   248	                crop = crop.resize((max(1, int(W * s)), max(1, int(H * s))), Image.BILINEAR).resize((W, H), Image.BILINEAR)
   249	            if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   250	                crop = ImageEnhance.Brightness(crop).enhance(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2))
   251	            if rng.rand() < 0.5:
   252	                crop = ImageEnhance.Contrast(crop).enhance(rng.uniform(0.8, 1.2))
   253	        out.append(crop)
   254	    return out

   257	def pil_to_tensor_np(img):
   258	    """PIL 384x128 -> normalized CHW float32 ndarray (matches dataset _image_to_tensor)."""
   259	    arr = np.asarray(img, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0          # HWC
   260	    arr = (arr - PIXEL_MEAN) / PIXEL_STD
   261	    return arr.transpose(2, 0, 1)                            # CHW

   300	    def feats_from_pil(self, pil_list):

   310	            view = torch.zeros(t.shape[0], dtype=torch.long, device=t.device)
   311	            with torch.no_grad():

   313	            feat = out[0] if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)) else out
   314	            assert torch.is_tensor(feat) and feat.dim() == 2, \

   316	            feat = torch.nn.functional.normalize(feat, p=2, dim=1)

   324	def eval_map(dist, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam, max_rank=10):
   325	    num_q = dist.shape[0]
   326	    idx = np.argsort(dist, axis=1)
   327	    all_AP, all_cmc, nv = [], [], 0
   328	    for i in range(num_q):
   329	        order = idx[i]
   330	        keep = ~((g_pid[order] == q_pid[i]) & (g_cam[order] == q_cam[i]))
   331	        m = (g_pid[order][keep] == q_pid[i]).astype(np.int32)
   332	        if not m.any():
   333	            continue
   334	        nv += 1
   335	        cmc = m.cumsum(); cmc[cmc > 1] = 1
   336	        all_cmc.append(cmc[:max_rank])
   337	        tmp = m.cumsum(); prec = tmp / (np.arange(len(m)) + 1.0)
   338	        all_AP.append((prec * m).sum() / m.sum())
   339	    all_cmc = np.asarray(all_cmc).mean(0)
   340	    return dict(mAP=float(np.mean(all_AP)) * 100, r1=float(all_cmc[0]) * 100,
   341	                r5=float(all_cmc[4]) * 100, r10=float(all_cmc[9]) * 100, nq=nv)
   342	
   343	
   344	def per_query_ap(dist, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam):
   345	    num_q = dist.shape[0]
   346	    idx = np.argsort(dist, axis=1)
   347	    aps = np.full(num_q, -1.0)
   348	    for i in range(num_q):
   349	        order = idx[i]
   350	        keep = ~((g_pid[order] == q_pid[i]) & (g_cam[order] == q_cam[i]))
   351	        m = (g_pid[order][keep] == q_pid[i]).astype(np.int32)
   352	        if not m.any():
   353	            continue
   354	        prec = m.cumsum() / (np.arange(len(m)) + 1.0)
   355	        aps[i] = (prec * m).sum() / m.sum()
   356	    return aps

   359	def n_false_in_topk(dist, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam, k=10):
   360	    """#wrong-identity gallery within the LR top-k (after junk removal). The TRIVIAL
   361	    failure proxy from Hubness §7.6 that the signal must survive."""
   362	    num_q = dist.shape[0]
   363	    idx = np.argsort(dist, axis=1)
   364	    nf = np.zeros(num_q)
   365	    for i in range(num_q):
   366	        order = idx[i]
   367	        keep = ~((g_pid[order] == q_pid[i]) & (g_cam[order] == q_cam[i]))
   368	        order_k = order[keep][:k]
   369	        nf[i] = int((g_pid[order_k] != q_pid[i]).sum())
   370	    return nf

   376	    ok = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y); x, y = x[ok], y[ok]
   377	    if len(x) < 3:
   378	        return float('nan'), 0
   379	    rx = np.argsort(np.argsort(x)).astype(float)
   380	    ry = np.argsort(np.argsort(y)).astype(float)

    63	def variant_feats(its, cap=0, batch=256):

    78	class LCRS(torch.nn.Module):
    79	    """z_k = norm(P_shared(g_k) + alpha * P_axis[k%n_axis](g_k))."""
    80	    def __init__(self, D, n_axis, alpha):
    81	        super().__init__()
    82	        self.shared = torch.nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False)
    83	        self.shared.weight.data.copy_(torch.eye(D))
    84	        self.axis = torch.nn.ModuleList([torch.nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False) for _ in range(n_axis)])
    85	        for a in self.axis:
    86	            a.weight.data.zero_()                              # residual init 0 (start = shared only)
    87	        self.alpha, self.n_axis = alpha, n_axis
    88	
    89	    def forward(self, g):                                      # g [..., K, D]
    90	        Kk = g.shape[-2]
    91	        sh = self.shared(g)                                    # [...,K,D]
    92	        res = torch.stack([self.axis[k % self.n_axis](g[..., k, :]) for k in range(Kk)], dim=-2)
    93	        return F.normalize(sh + self.alpha * res, dim=-1), res  # z [...,K,D], residual [...,K,D]

   106	    net = LCRS(D, cli.n_axis, cli.alpha).to(DEV)
   107	    opt = torch.optim.Adam(net.parameters(), lr=cli.lr)
   108	    eyeD = torch.eye(D, device=DEV)
   109	    iters = max(1, N // (cli.P * cli.Kins))
   110	    for ep in range(cli.epochs):

   114	            bidx = []
   115	            for y in bids:
   116	                pool = id2idx[int(y)]
   117	                bidx.extend(RNG.choice(pool, cli.Kins, replace=len(pool) < cli.Kins))
   118	            bidx = np.array(bidx)
   119	            z, res = net(ft_t[bidx])                            # z [b,K,D], res [b,K,D]
   120	            zg = z[:, 0]                                         # canonical-0 in-batch gallery
   121	            yb = yt[bidx]
   122	            pos = (yb[:, None] == yb[None, :]).float(); pos.fill_diagonal_(0)
   123	            npos = pos.sum(1).clamp_min(1.0)
   124	            # (codex bug1 fix) per-variant SupCon: 每个 z_k 单独检索 zg, 强制每 variant 都判别（非 logmeanexp 后）

   131	            l_id = (l_id / K).mean()

   133	            with torch.no_grad():

   154	    # ---- EVAL: K=9 marginalization with LCRS heads vs uniform(no-P) ----

     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""LPA head probe -- train-time mechanism A kill-switch.
     3	
     4	Frozen no-LM-loss backbone. Train a tiny per-variant RELIABILITY head on the TRAIN ids
     5	(predict each lattice variant's margin to its true id), then at TEST weight the K query
     6	variants by softmax(head) and marginalize.  Train/test ids are DISJOINT (no leakage).
     7	
     8	PASS  if  weighted-mAP - uniform-mAP >= +0.4  AND  head-argmax-variant matches the
     9	per-query best-margin (oracle) variant >= 35% (chance = 1/K = 11%).  Else LPA learned head
    10	is DEAD even though the oracle headroom is large -> the 'best variant' is not predictable.
    11	Reuses cvpb_lattice_killswitch helpers via a sys.argv shim (its argparse is module-level).
    12	"""
    13	import sys, os, numpy as np, argparse, time
    14	
    15	ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    16	ap.add_argument('--ckpt', default='log/market1501/exp359_abl_noLMloss/transformer_40.pth')
    17	ap.add_argument('--config', default='configs/market/pose_psg_lgpa_gcn_base.yml')
    18	ap.add_argument('--h', type=int, default=16)
    19	ap.add_argument('--K', type=int, default=9)
    20	ap.add_argument('--epochs', type=int, default=40)
    21	ap.add_argument('--lr', type=float, default=1e-3)
    22	ap.add_argument('--tau', type=float, default=0.5)
    23	ap.add_argument('--train_cap', type=int, default=0)        # 0 = all train imgs
    24	ap.add_argument('--cache_gallery', default='/tmp/g_lpa_head.npz')
    25	lpa = ap.parse_args()

    27	# the kill-switch parses argv at import time -> feed it the args its FrozenExtractor needs.
    28	sys.argv = ['ks', '--ckpt', lpa.ckpt, '--config', lpa.config, '--data_root', 'data',
    29	            '--K', str(lpa.K), '--reuse_gallery', '--cache_gallery', lpa.cache_gallery]
    30	sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    31	import cvpb_lattice_killswitch as ks
    32	import torch
    33	from datasets.bases import read_image
    34	
    35	RNG = np.random.RandomState(42)
    36	H, K = lpa.h, lpa.K
    37	ext = ks.FrozenExtractor()
    38	REPO = ks._repo
    39	
    40	
    41	def items(split):
    42	    return ks.list_split(os.path.join(REPO, 'data', 'market1501', split))
    43	
    44	
    45	def variant_feats(its, cap=0):
    46	    """[N,K,D] frozen L2-normed features of K lattice variants (variant 0 = canonical LR)."""
    47	    if cap:
    48	        its = its[:cap]
    49	    pids = np.array([it[1] for it in its]); cams = np.array([it[2] for it in its])
    50	    flat = []
    51	    for it in its:
    52	        hr = ks._to_target_aspect(read_image(it[0]))
    53	        flat.extend(ks.make_lattice_variants(hr, H, K, RNG))     # K PILs
    54	    f = ext.feats_from_pil(flat).reshape(len(its), K, -1)        # [N,K,D]
    55	    return f.astype(np.float32), pids, cams
    56	
    57	
    58	def per_variant_margin(f, y):
    59	    """margin[n,k] = sim(f_k, true_center) - max_wrong sim(f_k, center).  centers = per-id
    60	    mean of CANONICAL (variant 0) feat.  Returns margin [N,K] and best-variant [N]."""
    61	    uy = np.unique(y)
    62	    cen = np.stack([f[y == c, 0].mean(0) for c in uy]).astype(np.float32)
    63	    cen /= (np.linalg.norm(cen, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)
    64	    yi = np.array([{c: i for i, c in enumerate(uy)}[v] for v in y])
    65	    N = len(y)
    66	    sim = f @ cen.T                                              # [N,K,C]
    67	    true_s = sim[np.arange(N)[:, None], np.arange(K)[None, :], yi[:, None]]   # [N,K]
    68	    wrong = sim.copy(); wrong[np.arange(N), :, yi] = -1e9
    69	    margin = true_s - wrong.max(2)                              # [N,K]
    70	    return margin, margin.argmax(1)
    71	
    72	
    73	# ---- 1. TRAIN: extract variant feats + per-variant margin labels ----
    74	t0 = time.time()
    75	print(f"[LPA] extract TRAIN variant feats (h={H}, K={K}) ...", flush=True)
    76	ft, ytr, _ = variant_feats(items('bounding_box_train'), cap=lpa.train_cap)
    77	N, _, D = ft.shape
    78	margin_tr, best_tr = per_variant_margin(ft, ytr)
    79	print(f"[LPA] train: N={N} D={D}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    80	
    81	# ---- 2. train the reliability head H(f)->scalar (predict normalized margin) ----
    82	dev = 'cuda'

    89	for ep in range(lpa.epochs):

    91	    last = 0.0
    92	    for s in range(0, N * K, 4096):
    93	        idx = perm[s:s + 4096]
    94	        loss = torch.nn.functional.smooth_l1_loss(head(Xt[idx]).squeeze(1), Mt[idx])
    95	        opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step(); last = loss.item()
    96	print(f"[LPA] head trained {lpa.epochs}ep, final loss={last:.4f}", flush=True)
    97	
    98	# ---- 3. TEST: weighted vs uniform marginalization ----
    99	print("[LPA] extract QUERY variant feats ...", flush=True)
   100	fq, q_pid, q_cam = variant_feats(items('query'))
   101	if os.path.exists(lpa.cache_gallery):
   102	    gf = np.load(lpa.cache_gallery, allow_pickle=True)['gf']
   103	else:
   104	    gits = items('bounding_box_test')
   105	    gf = ext.feats_from_pil([ks._to_target_aspect(read_image(it[0])) for it in gits])
   106	    np.savez(lpa.cache_gallery, gf=gf)
   107	gits = items('bounding_box_test')
   108	g_pid = np.array([it[1] for it in gits]); g_cam = np.array([it[2] for it in gits])
   109	
   110	Xq = torch.tensor(fq.reshape(-1, D), device=dev)
   111	with torch.no_grad():
   112	    a = head(Xq).reshape(len(q_pid), K).cpu().numpy()           # [Nq,K] reliability logits
   113	w = np.exp(a / lpa.tau); w /= w.sum(1, keepdims=True)           # [Nq,K] weights
   114	sim_q = fq @ gf.T                                              # [Nq,K,Ng]
   115	r_uni = ks.eval_map(1 - sim_q.mean(1), q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   116	r_w = ks.eval_map(1 - (w[:, :, None] * sim_q).sum(1), q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   117	
   118	# diagnostic: does head's argmax match the per-query ORACLE best variant on TEST?
   119	margin_te, best_te = per_variant_margin(fq, q_pid)
   120	acc = float((a.argmax(1) == best_te).mean())
   121	delta = r_w['mAP'] - r_uni['mAP']
   122	print(f"\n[LPA RESULT h={H}]  uniform mAP={r_uni['mAP']:.3f}  weighted mAP={r_w['mAP']:.3f}  "
   123	      f"(weighted-uniform={delta:+.3f})")
   124	print(f"[LPA DIAG] head-argmax == oracle-best-variant acc={100*acc:.1f}%  (chance={100.0/K:.1f}%)")
   125	print(f"[LPA VERDICT] {'PASS (mechanism A lives)' if (delta >= 0.4 and acc >= 0.35) else 'FAIL (best variant not predictable from feature)'}"
   126	      f"  -- need weighted-uniform>=+0.4 AND acc>=35%")
   127	print("[done] LPA head probe complete.")
